scene_prompt:
A peaceful train station waiting area during soft morning light in a flat vintage rubberhose cartoon style. Warm sunlight streams through tall station windows onto a simple wooden bench and tiled floor. Keep the composition extremely clean and easy to read with only 5 main focal groups: the waiting bench, a rolling suitcase, a station map board, a small snack cart, and a trail of treasure hunt clues.

On the bench: an open backpack with colorful folded maps peeking out, a compass beside a rolled treasure map tied with red string, and a small flashlight resting near a yellow ticket. Nearby, a bright red suitcase sits slightly open with shiny toy coins spilling out onto the floor. A trail of small paper arrows leads from the suitcase toward the station map board.

Funny unexpected detail: a tiny toy pirate hat is sitting on top of an apple on the snack cart as if someone dressed it up for the treasure hunt. Another playful detail: one golden coin is balanced upright on the edge of the bench instead of lying flat.

Include around 10 clear visible details total. Use colorful objects with memorable placements and environmental storytelling strongly suggesting someone was secretly setting up a treasure hunt before a train trip. Soft glowing morning palette with warm sunlight patches, cozy shadows, clean readable silhouettes, simple shapes, minimal clutter, no text labels, no logos, no UI.

questions.question_text: What color was the suitcase with the coins spilling out?
What was most likely being prepared in the station waiting area?
What object was beside the rolled treasure map on the bench?
What unusual item was sitting on top of the apple on the snack cart?
What suggested that clues had been hidden around the station?

answers.answer_text: The paper arrows leading across the floor
